title.narrative: Sociobioeconomy - Entrepreneurship to ensure rights and conserve Amazonia: CONEXSUS

description.narrative: The Project’s expected effect(s) on society is to seed and foster an inclusive and forest friendly sociobioeconomy that reduces deforestation and carbon emissions from land-use and land-use change (Impact). The expected effects (Outcomes) for the target group of the Project are three-fold: 1. Community-led enterprises located in regional business ecosystems are engaged in initiatives to improve their organisational structure, management practices and commercial diversification. 2. Increase capacity of community-led enterprises to access sustainable financing. 3. Improve understanding on the contribution of the community enterprises to forest conservation and the reduction of deforestation and carbon emission. The intended target group is community-led enterprises involved in standing forest bioeconomy and small-scale deforestation-free agriculture, composed of regional community business ecosystems made of family farmers and groups of both local and traditional communities.
